```yaml
name: Devin on Label

on:
  issues:
    types: [labeled]

jobs:
  devin-session:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install jq
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Get issue details
        id: get_issue_details
        run: |
          echo "::set-output name=title::$(jq -r '.issue.title' $GITHUB_EVENT_PATH)"
          echo "::set-output name=url::$(jq -r '.repository.html_url' $GITHUB_EVENT_PATH)/issues/$(jq -r '.issue.number' $GITHUB_EVENT_PATH)"
          echo "::set-output name<body::$(jq -r '.issue.body' $GITHUB_EVENT_PATH)"

      - name: Call Devin API
        env:
          DEVIN_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.DEVIN_API_KEY }}
          ISSUE_TITLE: ${{ steps.get_issue_details.outputs.title }}
          ISSUE_URL: ${{ steps.get_issue_details.outputs.url }}
          ISSUE_BODY: ${{ steps.get_issue_details.outputs.body }}
        run: |
          curl -X POST "https://api.devin.ai/v1/sessions" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEVIN_API_KEY" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "{\"prompt\": \"$ISSUE_TITLE\\n$ISSUE_URL\\n$ISSUE_BODY\"}" \
            > session_response.json

      - name: Extract session URL
        id: extract_session_url
        run: echo "::set-output name=session_url::$(jq -r '.session_url' session_response.json)"

      - name: Comment on issue with session URL
        id: comment_on_issue
        uses: actions/github-script@v5
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const issueNumber = context.payload.issue.number;
            const sessionUrl = process.env.SESSION_URL;
            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: issueNumber,
              body: `Devin session created: <${sessionUrl}|Open Session>`
            });
```
